items.title: UK Trade Marks Journal dataset: weekly accepted applications with classes, applicant and opposition deadline (+ stats page, Apify actor)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W39 winner. Watch services charge £180–320/mark/yr to scan this journal; Apify UK trademark actor $0.05/record. Weekly OGL XML (~15 MB zip) from ipo.gov.uk/t-tmj.htm; rolling 52 issues; own Saturday wave. Schema undocumented and ipo.gov.uk unreachable from the routine container — write from a sample, hand off verification. Organisation-level fields only. Built 2026-09-23 (wave 7 at 06:05, v0.15.0, Apify actor): layout-tolerant XML reader written blind — verification handoff in ALERTS.md.
items.proof: queries + paywall hits + get_changes calls on the dataset in 30 days (Analytics Engine); Apify paid runs once actors unblock

items.title: Gambling Commission operator register dataset (operators, premises, regulatory actions)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W39 runner-up. 2,642 operators, daily CSV/ZIP, no login; Apify actors price it from $8/1k rows; KYB/payments/affiliate-compliance buyers. LICENCE CONFIRMED 2026-09-24 by the interactive session: data.gov.uk record 'Operator licence register' (Gambling Commission) is marked UK Open Government Licence v3 (rel=dc:rights → nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/; CKAN license_id uk-ogl). Files under https://www.gamblingcommission.gov.uk/downloads/ (all 200, text/csv, no login, browser UA): business-licence-register-businesses.csv (Account Number,Licence Account Name; 92 KB), business-licence-register-licences.csv (Account Number,Licence Number,Status,Type,Activity,Start Date,End Date; 493 KB), business-licence-register-trading-names.csv (Account Number,Trading Name,Status), business-licence-register-domain-names.csv (Account Number,Domain Name,Status), premises-licence-register.csv (Account Number,Account Name,Premises Activity,Local Authority,Address Line 1,Address Line 2,City,Postcode). business-licence-register-activities.csv does NOT exist (404). Values are double-quoted, blank dates empty.
items.proof: queries + paywall hits on the dataset in 30 days (Analytics Engine)

items.title: Fix the nhs-ods refresh error reported in the 2026-09-23 metrics row
items.why: First live wave-6 run (05:55) errored. The ingest was written without access to files.digital.nhs.uk and the build container still has no egress to NHS hosts or to gankdat.com, so the refresh_log message cannot be read from a routine; the fix needs the error text. RESOLVED 2026-09-24 (interactive): refresh_log said `ODS etr.zip download failed: 403` — files.digital.nhs.uk/assets/ods/current/<file>.zip now 403s for every user agent (only the *arc archive ZIPs remain); the current reports moved to https://www.odsdatasearchandexport.nhs.uk/api/getReport?report=<file>, served as plain CSV (all six files 200 with the Worker's UA, same 27-column layout). Source rewired, ZIP step dropped.
items.proof: nhs-ods loads ~45k rows and the metrics row shows no refresh error
